description: Honour and sincerity rules applied to ES-NFT search behaviour. Extends the search honour policy with minting-specific and engine-level deltas.

aligned_search_results.condition: Search produces clean, aligned results with high 7-Leaf score

clean_query.condition: Query is clear, non-harmful, and purpose-aligned

neutral_query.condition: Query is ambiguous or low-signal but not harmful

manipulative_ranking.condition: Attempting to manipulate search results, hide harmful content, or game alignment scores

harmful_query.condition: Exploitative, manipulative, or socially damaging query intent detected

spam_query.condition: Spammy, repetitive, or low-effort manipulative pattern detected

earth_leaf_violation.condition: Search ignores Earth leaf constraints (legality, safety, regional restrictions)

bias_index_rules.description: Bias index tracks whether the search engine is producing neutral, balanced results.

safety_integrity_rules.description: Safety integrity degrades when search produces or facilitates harmful content.

clean_search.condition: Search completes with no safety flags

safety_flag_raised.condition: A safety flag was raised during search

blocked_search.condition: Search was blocked due to safety violation

gating_rules.honour_recovery_path: Frozen DIDs must wait 24h or complete a guided honour repair to restore search access.
